text:
To be honest, I think svt is the most well rounded gp. All kpop groups are talented but svt talents are too good to be true 
💎 Literally all seventeen members are all rounders, can sing, rap and dance like main dancer. Even main dancer and main rapper can do Highnotes 😭🥰
💎 they are athletics and really good at sport too such as running, archery, football, volleyball etc. Even in ISAAC history, they especially DK set the highest score for archery and till now no one surpass him yet. In terms of acting, Jun is a child actor back then in china and even won best child actor. He even acted in IPMan movie.  Dk also have been musical actor 2 times already. Joshua have a cameo in a-teen drama too.  mingyu also have acted in Thai drama back then in 2018. And actually, u can see their acting skills in going seventeen, skit during concert and kcon etc especially wonwoo, seungkwan, jeonghan, etc. I hope one day pledis will give a chance for them to act in kdrama soon bcs they have been focus too much on group activities more than solo activities. Only this year, they started to push up the solo activities such as mixtape hoshi spider, members solo magazine etc.
💎 In terms of entertainment,no need to say. Seungkwan even won best rookie idol entertainer during 2018. All their shows are so entertaining especially going seventeen, that's why even non kpopers, non carats and other idols like nct, cravity, p1harmony, cix, to1 etc also watch it🥰plus their chemistry is really something else that u can even easily put any pair and there's never awkward moments between them. Their bonding is so precious and they're so affectionate with each other till they will feel jealous if some members close with another group (in a good way lol).  Although they have many members, they still stay strong together as ot13 without any members left behind for more than 6 years since debut until now despite having foreign members and comes from sh**ty company 🙌😌
💎in terms of performance, they're known as king of performance for a reason. They never repeat the same performance. Their discography music is one of the best in kpop ngl, Thats why they never afraid to perform their old songs or bside tracks. u can see they always performed b-side tracks on award shows such as MAMA 2018 and 2019, GAON chart award, TMA award etc. Even non carats love their performance and said the songs and performances are so good! Even on western shows, they performed Aju nice (from 2016), b-side tracks from them age album etc. And their stage presence are so good too.  "Seventeen is The most complete Kpop group in terms of talent and music qualities" 
Yes indeed Seventeen are well rounded in ALL sense , they aren't afraid of experimenting with different genres and that's what sets them apart making them such a versatile group. They also have amazing personalities and so humble, many staff from music show, varietyshows always praised them for their personalities 🤧✊ and many of them can cook really well too! 
💎 Many of them can also play instruments like clarinet, piano, guitar, bass guitar, electronic guitar, flute etc. All of members have credit on KOMCA. All members can compose song etc. 
💎Their self producing term is on another level, they made their own music, dance, and have directed and produced Mv, merchandise, self photobook magazines, their own fanchant (literally trained carats to become a singer, rapper, and dancer, try watch hit fanchant, fallin flower fanchant, left and right fanchant),  etc to the point they can made their own company 🥺🤧 u will know once u dig deeper into them srsly:) or I recommend you to watch seventeen hit the road.
